earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: Third quarter net sales grew 7.1 percent over last year, with comparable sales growth of 5.6 percent driven by a 5.0 percent increase in comparable traffic.

Net sales grew across a majority of core merchandising categories versus a year ago, including nearly 27 percent growth in Fun 101, more than 9 percent growth in Beauty, and nearly 7 percent growth in Food and Beverage.
Third quarter GAAP and Adjusted EPS 1 were $2.65 compared with last year’s GAAP EPS of $1.51 and Adjusted EPS of $1.78.
Excluding tariff refunds, GAAP EPS would have increased 42 percent, and Adjusted EPS would have increased 21 percent, when compared with the prior year.
Store comparable sales grew 4.6 percent, and digital comparable sales grew 9.8 percent.

quotes.text: Our third-quarter results reflect continued progress against our strategic priorities, centered on serving busy families with our signature blend of style, design and value.
quotes.by: Michael Fiddelke, Chief Executive Officer of Target

outlook: Full-year net sales growth in a range around 6 percent, one percentage point higher than the prior guidance range.
Full-year 2026 operating income margin rate in a range around 6.2 percent, including approximately 1.1 percentage points of benefit from tariff refunds recognized to date.
An updated GAAP and Adjusted EPS guidance range of $10.65 to $11.40, which includes approximately $2.14 in tariff refund benefits recognized to date.
Additionally, building on the strong returns generated by capital investments in 2026, the Company expects to invest between $5 billion and $6 billion in capital expenditures in 2027.

items.heading: If we are unable to positively differentiate ourselves from our competitors, our results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected.
If we do not anticipate consumer demand accurately and respond quickly to changing consumer preferences, our results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected.
Our continued success is dependent on positive perceptions of Target which, if eroded, could adversely affect our business and our relationships, including with our guests, team members, and vendors.
Our business transformation initiatives may not achieve their intended objectives, which could adversely affect our competitive position, results of operations, and financial condition.
If we are unable to successfully develop, source, and market our owned and exclusive brand products, our results of operations could be adversely affected.
If we are unable to protect against inventory shrink, our results of operations and financial condition could be adversely affected.
